The '''Skandrei Bandits''' were a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who operated in the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A successful organization, they targeted the colonies and settlements located throughout the Outback. Generally, they raided one or two settlements a month, stealing high-tech equipment and foodstuffs. Anything they had no real use for was sold on to other colonies through third parties, or sold on [[Pembric II]].

The Bandits operated a fleet of six or seven small [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], such as modified [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Etti Lighter]]s and several [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The fleet was generally split into several smaller units, and would only come together to hit a potentially valuable or well-defended target.

Their base of operations was unknown, although rumors persisted that they maintained a space station in the expanse of the [[Marcol Void/Legends|Marcol Void]].

The success and firepower of the Bandits caused colonies and settlements to engage in mutual defense treaties, or band together in political union.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Gorak Khzam]] led the Bandits to [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]] to obtain [[DarkStryder technology]]. They fought in the [[Battle of Kathol System]], and were targeted heavily by the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] ships.
